audit.why: The packet figure is 46.06% over 317 games.
Vladimir 1-5, Yi at 6 and first item, Vladimir at 2+ items. phases[].side and win[] agree row for row with the packet chart and the mirror.
Level 6 Highlander then first on-hit item, against his ult amp and his three-item scaling — consistent across both layers and with the chart flip at index 6.
audit.corrected: No spike restructuring; Sanguine Pool's real cooldown added so the window is dateable.

audit.why: The decisive interaction — Sanguine Pool's untargetability eating a committed Alpha Strike plus Highlander — is already stated in focus.text, report[5], spikes[0] and early, and matches the kit's untargetable flag. Alpha Strike's own untargetability answering his ult-timed burst is also already there.
audit.corrected: Added the exact 2-second untargetable duration to breakdown.cooldowns so the bait window is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the trading or spike advice told you to apply Grievous Wounds before committing.
audit.why: Transfusion heals on a 9s-down-to-4.6s cooldown at zero cost and Hemoplague heals him per champion hit. Both carry the heal flag, so anti-heal timing, not raw DPS, decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into breakdown.trading and spikes[2].text.

edits.before: Track Sanguine Pool (W) above all — it's ~26-28s early and it eats your entire committed Alpha Strike+Highlander burst. Only all-in when you've baited or seen it used.
edits.after: Track Sanguine Pool (W) above all — 28s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5, and 2s untargetable that eats your whole Alpha Strike plus Highlander commit. All-in only after you see it used.

edits.before: Short trades only until you itemize: Wuju Style on, Q-reset onto him, one or two on-hit autos, disengage before his Transfusion heals the difference. Never sit in his E-Q poke range trading autos straight up — his sustain wins the war of attrition every time pre-6.
edits.after: Short trades only until you itemize: Wuju Style on, Q-reset onto him, one or two on-hit autos, disengage before Transfusion heals the difference back. Apply Grievous Wounds before you commit — Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him, and unshredded that healing decides every long trade you take.

edits.before: TRICKY (46.41% WR) — Vladimir edges the lane with poke, sustain, and his Pool, but Yi owns level 6 and the 2-item window; win it there or lose it to his scaling.
edits.after: TRICKY (46.06% WR) — Vladimir edges the lane with poke, sustain, and his Pool, but Yi owns level 6 and the 2-item window; win it there or lose it to his scaling.

edits.before: With first item plus R your Wuju true damage out-DPS his sustain — you drop him faster than Transfusion can heal, provided you catch him with W down. All-in aggressively here while you're ahead of his scaling curve.
edits.after: With first item plus R your Wuju true damage out-DPS his sustain — you drop him faster than Transfusion can heal, provided you catch him with W down and have Grievous Wounds already on him. All-in here while you lead his curve.
